name: Pocket Markwhen
changes: The Pro section now shows Combine files and Export Markdown list without Pro. A click shows how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, and reads or writes no file.
tip: Select Today to jump to the first event on or after the current day.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pocket Markwhen is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
